from fr_ir.runtime import FrClient
from fr_ir.guide import AgentGoal, GoalSelector, GoalOperation, GoalConstraints, GoalLimits
from fr_ir.ir import TaskChange, TaskDelivery, TaskTarget
from fr_ir.intent_actions import TaggedIntentAction, TaskChangeOperation
client = FrClient('.')
guide = client.guide(AgentGoal('change',
    selector=GoalSelector(name='normalize', scope='text.py'),
    operation=GoalOperation('source-body'), constraints=GoalConstraints(allow_source=True),
    context=GoalLimits(packet_limit=65536), checks=('behavior',),
    delivery=TaskDelivery(patch='artifacts/change.patch', check_output_bytes=512)))
authored = {('text.py', 'normalize'): 'return value.strip().upper()\n'}
data = guide.to_data()
rows = data.get('targets', [data['target']])
assert len(rows) == len(authored)
assert {(r['path'], r['name']) for r in rows} == set(authored)
bodies = {r['handle']: authored[(r['path'], r['name'])] for r in rows}
paths = sorted({r['path'] for r in rows})
change = TaskChange((), tuple(TaskTarget(f'body-{i}', r['handle'],
    'replace-body', fragment=bodies[r['handle']]) for i, r in enumerate(rows)),
    {'files-changed': len(paths), 'edits': len(rows),
     'changed-operations': len(rows), 'paths-changed': paths},
    guide.goal.checks, guide.goal.delivery)
action = TaggedIntentAction(TaskChangeOperation(change),
    diff_bytes=guide.goal.context.token_limit, report_bytes=guide.goal.context.packet_limit,
    proof_expectation=guide.goal.proof)
review = client.review_guide(guide, action)
result = client.execute_guide(review).to_data()
submission = {'passed': result['passed'], 'transaction': result['transaction']}
